name: Canyon Moon Palace — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Apricot sandstone palace attached to a vertical canyon shelf, turquoise onion domes, tall star banners, huge circular gilded moon screen/entry and water spilling between lower arches/rock piers. Iso climbs along the cliff; mini-plan is elongated with rounded room/tower ends. Hidden layout inference: A lower ledge arrival climbs a switchback garden stair to the moon-screen court, then to one sheltered upper dome terrace. Separate dry cliff-edge overlooks from lush irrigated court pockets; channels feed controlled falls and stay away from walking edges. Back depth/return route are inferred. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B10-STRUCT-001 — Canyon Moon Palace — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need cliff-embedded wall/round-tower hosts, moon-screen support/reveal, terrace/stair cutback and ghat/water-outlet junctions. Existing turquoise scale tiles, banners and moon lattice should be extracted. Dry shrubs/lizards plus palms/flowers near water; shared cliff/water families. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

B10-STRUCT-001-S01 — Cliff-embedded wall. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 6, 12]m proposed. One isolated cliff-embedded wall matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
